description.zh:
指定该Object被下载时的网页的缓存行为。更多信息，请参见**[RFC 2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**。
默认值：无
description.en:
The web page caching behavior when the object is downloaded. For more information, see **[RFC 2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**.
Default value: null.

description.zh:
指定该Object被下载时的名称。更多信息，请参见**[RFC 2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**。
默认值：无
description.en:
The name of the object when it is downloaded. For more information, see **[RFC 2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**.
Default value: null.

description.zh:
指定该Object被下载时的内容编码格式。更多信息，请参见**[RFC 2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**。
默认值：无
description.en:
The content encoding format of the object when it is downloaded. For more information, see **[RFC 2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**.
Default value: null.

description.zh:
过期时间，单位为毫秒。更多信息，请参见**[RFC 2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**。
默认值：无
description.en:
The expiration time, in milliseconds. For more information, see **[RFC 2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**.
Default value: null.

description.zh: 初始化一个Multipart Upload事件的Bucket名称。
description.en: The name of the bucket in which to initialize a multipart upload event.

description.zh:
指定对返回的Key进行编码，目前支持URL编码。Key使用UTF-8字符，但XML 1.0标准不支持解析一些控制字符，例如ASCII值从0到10的字符。对于Key中包含XML
                              1.0标准不支持的控制字符，可以通过指定encoding-type对返回的Key进行编码。
默认值：无
可选值：**url**
description.en:
The encoding type for the returned key. URL encoding is supported. Keys use UTF-8 characters, but XML 1.0 does not support parsing certain control characters, such as characters with ASCII values from 0 to 10. If a key contains control characters that are not supported by XML 1.0, specify encoding-type to encode the returned key.
Default value: null.
Valid value: **url**.

description.zh: 初始化一个Multipart Upload事件的Object名称。
description.en: The name of the object for which to initialize a multipart upload event.

description.zh:
指定InitiateMultipartUpload操作时是否覆盖同名Object。当目标Bucket处于已开启或已暂停的版本控制状态时，**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**请求Header设置无效，即允许覆盖同名Object。
  - 不指定**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**或者指定**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**为**false**时，表示允许覆盖同名Object。
  - 指定**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**为**true**时，表示禁止覆盖同名Object。

设置**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**请求Header会导致QPS处理性能下降，如果您有大量的操作需要使用**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**请求Header（QPS>1000），请联系技术支持，避免影响您的业务。
description.en:
Specifies whether to overwrite an existing object with the same name during the InitiateMultipartUpload operation. When the destination bucket is in the enabled or suspended versioning state, the **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** request header is invalid, and existing objects with the same name can be overwritten.
  - If **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** is not specified or is set to **false**, an existing object with the same name can be overwritten.
  - If **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** is set to **true**, an existing object with the same name cannot be overwritten.

Setting the **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** request header degrades QPS processing performance. If you need to use the **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** request header for a large number of operations (QPS > 1000), contact technical support to avoid impact on your business.

description.zh:
指定Object的加密算法。若未指定此选项，表明Object使用AES256加密算法。此选项仅当**x-oss-server-side-encryption**为KMS时有效。
取值：SM4
description.en:
The encryption algorithm for the object. If this option is not specified, the object is encrypted by using AES256. This option is valid only when **x-oss-server-side-encryption** is set to KMS.
Valid value: SM4.

description.zh:
指定上传该Object的每个part时使用的服务器端加密方式。
取值：**AES256**、**KMS**或**SM4**
> 使用KMS加密算法前，您需要先开通密钥管理服务KMS。


指定此参数后，在响应头中会返回此参数，OSS会对上传的每个part进行加密编码存储。当下载该Object时，响应头中会包含x-oss-server-side-encryption，且该值会被设置成此Object的加密算法。
description.en:
The server-side encryption method used when uploading each part of the object.
Valid values: **AES256**, **KMS**, or **SM4**
> Before using the KMS encryption algorithm, activate Key Management Service (KMS).


After you specify this parameter, the response header returns this parameter. OSS encrypts and stores each uploaded part. When you download the object, the response header includes x-oss-server-side-encryption, and the value is set to the encryption algorithm of the object.

description.zh:
表示KMS托管的用户主密钥。
该参数在**x-oss-server-side-encryption**值为KMS时有效。
description.en:
The ID of the customer master key (CMK) hosted in KMS.
This parameter is valid only when **x-oss-server-side-encryption** is set to KMS.

description.zh:
指定Object的存储类型。
对于任意存储类型Bucket，如果上传Object时指定该值，则此次上传的Object将存储为指定的类型。例如在IA类型的Bucket中上传Object时，如果指定**x-oss-storage-class**为Standard，则该Object直接存储为Standard类型。
取值：

- Standard：标准存储
- IA：低频访问
- Archive：归档存储
- ColdArchive：冷归档存储

关于存储类型的更多信息，请参见**[存储类型介绍](~~51374~~)**。
description.en:
The storage class of the object.
For a bucket of any storage class, if you specify this value when uploading an object, the object is stored as the specified storage class. For example, if you set **x-oss-storage-class** to Standard when uploading an object to an Infrequent Access bucket, the object is stored as Standard.
Valid values:

- Standard
- IA: Infrequent Access
- Archive
- ColdArchive: Cold Archive

For more information about storage classes, see **[Overview of storage classes](~~51374~~)**.

description.zh:
指定Object的标签，可同时设置多个标签，例如： TagA=A&TagB=B
> Key和Value需要先进行URL编码，如果某项没有`=`，则看作Value为空字符串。
description.en:
The tags of the object. You can set multiple tags at the same time, for example, TagA=A&TagB=B.
> The key and value must be URL-encoded. If an entry does not contain `=`, the value is treated as an empty string.

title.zh: 通知OSS初始化分片上传事件
title.en: Notify OSS to initialize a multipart upload event

descriptions.zh:
- 调用接口会返回一个OSS服务器创建的全局唯一的Upload ID，用于标识本次Multipart Upload事件。您可以根据这个ID来发起相关的操作，例如中止Multipart Upload、查询Multipart Upload等。

- 初始化MultipartUpload请求，并不影响已存在的同名Object。

- 该操作计算认证签名时，需要添加`?uploads`到`CanonicalizedResource`中。
descriptions.en:
- This operation returns a globally unique Upload ID created by the OSS server. This ID identifies the multipart upload event. You can use this ID to perform related operations, such as aborting or querying the multipart upload.

- Initializing a multipart upload request does not affect an existing object with the same name.

- When calculating the authentication signature for this operation, add `?uploads` to `CanonicalizedResource`.
